name: St. Regis Shanghai Jingan
insider_take: This ultra-luxe St. Regis sits in the heart of Shanghai's prestigious Jing'an district, where East meets West in perfect harmony amid towering skyscrapers and century-old temples.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 40-60 of a gleaming tower, offering breathtaking views of the Huangpu River and historic Bund. Each suite features the legendary St. Regis Butler Service, a tradition dating back to 1904 New York. The property houses China's first Iridium Spa and the city's highest champagne bar on the 58th floor.
pro_tip: Book afternoon tea at the 58th-floor bar during golden hour - you'll witness Shanghai's neon transformation while sipping champagne 200 meters above the bustling streets.
dont_miss: The Jing'an Temple, just steps away, where 2,000-year-old Buddhist traditions continue amid modern Shanghai. Visit the rooftop's signature Bloody Mary ritual, and explore nearby Nanjing West Road for world-class shopping at Plaza 66 and CITIC Square.
pros: Prime location in prestigious Jingan district with excellent shopping and dining access
Legendary St. Regis Butler Service providing personalized 24/7 assistance
Luxurious spacious rooms and suites with sophisticated contemporary design
Multiple award-winning dining venues including authentic Chinese cuisine
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
